## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n_raw = +3.2e12 (0 → 10 T), hole n_raw = −1.2e12 (10 → 0.3 T)

Both at (V_tg, V_bg) on the run-5 D = 0 line, T_sample 1.17 / 1.29 K, 10 nA, `sr1` 50 µV (5 kΩ FS, max fs 0.12 — no rail). Raw Rxx(B) first (left), then the SdH content: deg-5 B-space background removed vs 1/B (middle) and the `sdh_fft` spectra for three low-B cut-offs (right), with F_L at the raw-cal density (black) and at 0.89× (red, see the take). Per-tone onsets from `sdh_onset` printed below.

"""Runs 6 + 7 — `sdh-spot-check` at D = 0 (region-A cal, run 5). Raw Rxx(B) first, then the SdH content: deg-5 B-space
background removed and plotted vs 1/B, FFT spectra (hera.analysis.sdh_fft) for three low-B cut-offs, and the per-tone
onset read (sdh_onset). F_L marked at the raw-cal density and at 0.89x (see the take below)."""
import warnings
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset

spots = {6: ("electron", +3.2), 7: ("hole", -1.2)}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(17, 8.5))
for k, (rid, (side, n_raw)) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    chs = resolve_channels(r.meta); cur = current_channel(chs); vch = [c for c in chs if c.cid == "sr1"][0]
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain; R = (r.col(vch.col) / vch.gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]
    F_L_raw = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n_raw) * 1e16))
    # raw
    ax = axes[k, 0]; ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.8, color="C0"); ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx = (sr1_X/gain) / I_drain (Ohm)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {rid} raw — {side}, n_raw = {n_raw:+.1f}e12, D = 0; I = {np.nanmean(I)*1e9:.2f} nA, T = {r.meta['measurement_config'].get('sample_temperature:', float('nan')):.2f} K", fontsize=9)
    # SdH vs 1/B (B >= 1 T)
    m = B >= 1.0
    dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax = axes[k, 1]; ax.plot(1 / B[m], dR, lw=0.8, color="C0"); ax.set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax.set_ylabel("dRxx (Ohm), deg-5 bg in B removed")
    ax.set_title(f"run {rid} — SdH vs 1/B, B >= 1 T", fontsize=9)
    # spectra
    ax = axes[k, 2]
    for lo, c in ((1.0, "C0"), (1.5, "C1"), (2.5, "C2")):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, B.max()), bg_degree=5, log=False)
        sp = spec[0]; sp = sp / sp[f > 2].max()
        ax.plot(f, sp, c, lw=0.9, label=f"B in [{lo}, {B.max():.0f}] T")
        if lo == 1.5:
            pk, _ = find_peaks(sp, height=0.12, distance=3)
            pk = [p for p in pk if f[p] > 2]
            print(f"run {rid} FFT peaks (B 1.5-10 T, norm.): " + ", ".join(f"{f[p]:.1f} T ({sp[p]:.2f})" for p in pk))
            for p in pk: ax.annotate(f"{f[p]:.1f}", (f[p], sp[p]), fontsize=7, textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0, 3), ha="center")
    ax.axvline(F_L_raw, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L(n_raw) = {F_L_raw:.1f} T")
    ax.axvline(0.89 * F_L_raw, color="r", ls=":", lw=1, label=f"0.89 F_L = {0.89*F_L_raw:.1f} T")
    ax.set_xlim(0, 45); ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm. to max above 2 T)"); ax.set_title(f"run {rid} — SdH spectrum", fontsize=9); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    # onset read
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
        try:
            on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
            print(f"run {rid} ({side}): sdh_onset -> onset {on.onset_b:.2f} T carried by {on.onset_freq:.1f} T"
                  f"{' (censored: persists to record edge)' if any(t.censored and t.freq == on.onset_freq for t in on.tones) else ''}; noise sigma {on.noise_sigma:.1f} Ohm")
            for t in on.tones:
                print(f"   tone {t.freq:5.1f} T  contrast {t.contrast:6.1f}  onset {t.onset_b:.2f} T" + (f"  flagged ~{t.freq/t.harmonic_of:.1f}x of {t.harmonic_of:.1f}" if t.harmonic_of else "") + ("  near-residual" if t.near_residual else ""))
            if on.untracked: print("   untracked:", on.untracked)
        except ValueError as e:
            print(f"run {rid}: sdh_onset failed: {e}")
    print(f"   Rxx range {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (fs {R.max()/5e3:.2f} of the 5 kOhm scale); Rxx(10 T) = {R[-1]:.0f} Ohm; "
          f"drain current {I.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA\n")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6, 7).** *Electron side (run 6, `data/6`):* SdH from ≈ 1.0–1.4 T (the 22 T tone onsets at 1.36 T; the 7.1 T tone persists to the record edge), a clean QH minimum Rxx → 0 at **6.0 T**, then a 500 Ω structure at 7.7–10 T (max 8.7 T, min ≈ 9.7 T). Spectrum: **7.1 T** dominant (window 2.5–10 T), with **14.1 / 22.1–22.9 / 29.5–29.9 T**. `sdh_onset` flags the last three as ~2×/3×/4× of 7.1, but the resolution of this window (1/B span 0.64 T⁻¹ → ΔF ≈ 1.6 T) does not separate that from *light pocket 7.1 + heavy pocket 22 + total 29* — and **29.5–29.9 T ≈ 0.89–0.90 × F_L(n_raw = 3.2e12) = 33.1 T**. The high-B QH structure is periodic at F_L(true n), so the natural reading is that the run-5 **density scale is ~11 % high** (c_tg anchored at the 9.5 nm prior; the same factor the ratio calibration moved c_bg/c_tg by — i.e. it is c_tg, not c_bg, that misses the prior). At that scale 7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 ≈ F_L: a **two-pocket Fermi surface at D = 0** (light 24 % / heavy 76 %), which is what ABAB or ABCB give and ABCA does not (single pocket at F_L) — a lean, not a call, until the scale is measured. *Hole side (run 7, `data/7`):* dominant 5.3–6.6 T and 12.3 T (between F_L raw 12.4 and 0.89× = 11.0 — undecidable here), plus 4.7 / 9.4 / 14.8 T; onset 0.7–1.3 T. 4.7 + 6.6 ≈ 11.3 T is again a two-pocket sum at the rescaled F_L, but this close to the CNP the series region B (CNP at n_raw ≈ −0.43e12, so n_B ≈ −0.77e12 here, F_L,B ≈ 7–8 T) is a live confound for the 6.6 T tone. Neither trace rails; drain current 9.8–9.9 nA throughout; gate currents at their pA offsets. **Consequence for the plan:** the Landau fan (step 4) is the next step — its fan-line slopes fix the absolute n scale, and its n axis resolves pocket count and the zero-LL degeneracy directly, which these 1-D cuts cannot.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n fast over the full window, B 0 → 10 T

> **05:27** · landau-fan D=0 (run-5 cal): n fast -1.24..+3.21e12 x179 (0.025) co-swept Vtg/Vbg; B slow 0 T + 0.6->10.0 T 0.2 T (49 rows); sr1 100 uV; fast 1.0 s; ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~09:47** (≈4h20m)

**Plan step 4** (`hera_scratch/plan.md`; operator-requested). The spot checks (runs 6, 7 — ana read landed above) show SdH from ≈ 1.0–1.4 T and, on the electron side, tones at 7.1 / 14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T: at the spot-check FFT resolution (~1.6 T) "harmonics of 7.1" and "light pocket 7.1 + heavy pocket 22 + total 29" are indistinguishable, and 29.5 T ≈ 0.89 × F_L(n_raw) says the run-5 density *scale* (c_tg anchored at the 9.5 nm prior) is probably ~11 % high. The fan resolves all three at once: **(i)** fan-line slopes ν = n h/(eB) fix the absolute n scale, **(ii)** the first QH gaps around the CNP (ν = ±8 for ABAB/ABCA vs ±6 + e/h asymmetry for ABCB), **(iii)** LL crossings (two cyclotron masses: ABAB/ABCB) vs a clean single-band 4-step ladder (ABCA). The series region B (CNP offset −0.43e12 raw, run 5) will draw a replica fan converging to n ≈ −0.43 — read it as such, not as crossings.

**Design.** Fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5 D = 0 line (direction set by the data-calibrated ratio 0.773 + D_offset; only the n *labels* carry the scale uncertainty), n_raw = −1.24 … +3.21 ×10¹² in 0.025 steps (179 pts; 3.9 pts per LL period at 1 T, 7.7 at 2 T — the sub-1 T rows are baseline only). **Coverage trade:** the hole side stops at −1.24 (TG −0.3 V limit) and D is fixed at 0; ±D is plan step 5, and the operating box is not probed. Slow axis: a B = 0 baseline row (checks against run 5's D = 0 cut: CNP ≈ 300 Ω near n = 0, region-B peak near −0.43), then 0.6 → 10.0 T at 0.2 T (48 rows) — the magnet sits at 0 (handoff readback +0.003 T), so the fan runs up and ends at the 10 T cap; step 5 rides it down. `sr1` fixed at 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS (run-5 proven; a CNP rail above 10 kΩ at high B would itself be a read). Dwell fast 1.0 s (3.3 τ, run-5 calibrated), slow 3 s; leak guard 1 nA → interrupt + park.

**Price** (from run 5: 1.07 s/pt pure + flyback, ramp 0.2 T at 0.137 T/min = 88 s + 3 s settle per row): 179 × 1.07 + 3.6 + 3 + 91 ≈ 288 s/row × 48 + the 0 T row ≈ 3 h 58 m; with the session's 5–10 % overrun → **≈ 4 h 20 m**, 8771 points. **Checkpoints** (hera-watch `--next --follow` armed): *first rows* — the B = 0 row must reproduce run 5's D = 0 cut (else the line is wrong → abort), sensitivity and TG/BG currents at the electron end; *~3 T* (row ~13, ~1 h) and *~6 T* (row ~28, ~2.3 h) — re-form the landed fan, check that fan lines are visible and converge on the CNP, fit slopes for the n scale, look for crossings; abandon if the map is featureless above 2 T (then the read is T_e-limited and a fan at this T cannot decide) or if the CNP column rails across most of the row.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`): D = 0 line (region-A cal), n fast [-1.24, +3.21]e12 x 179 (0.025), B slow 0 T + 0.6 -> 10.0 T (0.2 T, 49 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration): ratio data-calibrated, ABSOLUTE SCALE = 9.5 nm geometry prior.
# Run 6's high-B tone (29.5 T vs F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T) says the scale is likely ~11 % high; the fan-line slopes measure it.
# n labels below are raw-cal; the D = 0 line direction depends only on the ratio + D_offset, so the line itself is right.
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.24, 3.2201, 0.025), 4)          # 1e12 cm^-2 raw cal, 179 pts; TG-limited both ends (~10 mV margin)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
_vt, _vb = sanitize_tg_bg(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, tg_lims, bg_lims)
assert len(_vt) == len(Vtg_vec), f"{len(Vtg_vec) - len(_vt)} fast points fall outside the validators"
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX
print(f"fast axis: n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts, 0.025) along D = 0 -> "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V; "
      f"roundtrip D at ends = {calc_nD(Vtg_vec[0], Vbg_vec[0], **CAL)[1]:+.4f}, {calc_nD(Vtg_vec[-1], Vbg_vec[-1], **CAL)[1]:+.4f} V/nm")

# --- field grid: B = 0 baseline row, then 0.6 -> 10.0 T at 0.2 T. Blocking magnet: start where it sits (0 T), end at the cap.
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack(([0.0], np.arange(0.6, 10.0001, 0.2))), 4))
assert B_vec.min() >= 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0     # fast 1.0 s = 3.3 tau at 0.3 s / 24 dB (run-5 calibrated: uniform ~1-pt lag along n)
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Run 5 read 60 Ohm..2.4 kOhm cleanly at this setting;
# the CNP at high B may soft-clip above 10 kOhm -- a localized, informative rail (insulating nu = 0), not a fault.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0 (run-5 cal): n fast {n_vec[0]:+.3f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 x {len(n_vec)} (0.025), "
                  f"B slow 0 + 0.6..10 T x {len(B_vec)} (0.2 T), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (region-A cal, run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); '
              f'n fast [{n_vec[0]:+.3f}, {n_vec[-1]:+.3f}]e12 {len(n_vec)} pts (0.025e12; Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.3f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.3f}, '
              f'Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.3f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.3f} V); B slow 0 T then 0.6 -> 10.0 T at 0.2 T ({len(B_vec)} rows); '
              f'Vsi = 0; T = {_T0:.2f} K; sr1 100 uV; n labels raw-cal (scale check pending from fan slopes)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)     # gates parked at 0; field stays where the sweep ended (the next step rides it down)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (held), gates parked (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
